bundle.shortDescription: Hall Monitor — WCP-governed AI worker orchestration
bundle.longDescription: Hall Monitor is the desktop companion to pyhall. It governs AI workers using the Worker Class Protocol (WCP): cryptographically attested, policy-gated, fully auditable. Run local or connect to a team Hall Server.
